svg.title: Shop schema
svg.desc: An order points to its user, and an order item points to its order and product through foreign keys

g.aria-label: order_items; id PK bigint; order_id FK NN bigint; product_id FK NN bigint; PK (id); FK (order_id) references orders (id) CASCADE; FK (product_id) references products (id)
products; id PK bigint; price NN numeric(10, 2); PK (id)
orders; id PK bigint; user_id FK NN bigint; status NN text; PK (id); FK (user_id) references users (id) RESTRICT
users; id PK bigint; email UNQ NN text; PK (id); UNQ (email)
